name: cold-start
description: The MCP client starts before Thunderbird (thunderbird-mcp issue #132). Without Thunderbird and without a cached tool list, the bridge answers initialize with tools.listChanged and tools/list with an empty list after its first-start wait, instead of an error; once Thunderbird is up it sends notifications/tools/list_changed, and the next tools/list and a tool call work.

checks.xfail: commonpost/thunderbird-mcp#132: up to 0.19.1, tools/list fails when the client starts before Thunderbird; fixed on main, strict once a release has the fix
